text:
ashley: FYI: canary promotion for release/2026.03.22 stalled. deploy-bot paused promotion due to staging-smoke failures (12/15 checks). CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release/2026.03.22. Failed checks: staging-smoke (12/15).

ashley: Snippet from staging job errors:
```
2026-03-22T14:07:23Z ERROR migration_runner: timeout waiting for advisory lock on migrations
2026-03-22T14:07:23Z INFO retrying migration 20260321_add_indexes.sql (attempt 3/3)
2026-03-22T14:07:30Z ERROR migration_runner: migration failed: could not acquire lock after 30s
```

sam: This smells like the advisory-lock contention we've seen when multiple test suites hit schema migrations in parallel. Restarting staging sometimes clears it.

maria: We only have a 2-hour change window. If rerun flakes we might miss the cutover.

jon: Choices: 1) reset staging DB and rerun (fast but flakey), 2) pin to last-known-good image and promote now, 3) halt and debug deeper before promoting.

sam: Given the window, pin & promote is lower risk. We can follow up with a hotfix + later rollout.

ashley: Proposed image: gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 (passed full smoke yesterday). Anyone object?

maria: +1. We should log the reason in release notes and add steps to the ops runbook on how to revert.

ashley: @deploy-bot please queue manual promote with that image. Command to run:
```
/deploy promote --image gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 --env prod --by ashley
```

deploy-bot: Manual promotion scheduled: release/2026.03.22 -> image gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 by ashley. ETA: 2026-03-22T16:00:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 4821`

ci-runner: Launching a diagnostic rerun (4821-rerun). I'll collect pg_locks, output of `SELECT * FROM pg_advisory_lock_status();`, and stack traces during the run for root cause.

jon: Add a short release-note blurb: "Promoted previous stable image due to intermittent DB migration advisory lock in staging; hotfix PR to follow."

ashley: I'll update the release notes and open a follow-up issue to address migration locking and add a targeted test harness.

maria: Please ensure the hotfix enforces deterministic advisory lock ordering or an explicit serialization guard.

ashley: Pin approved and promotion queued. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion completed successfully at 2026-03-22T16:01:12Z. Release pinned and promoted to prod.

ashley: Marking resolved. Follow-up issue created: #1234 (migration-lock-hotfix) and assigned to @sam.

sam: Acknowledged 12; will own the fix and post updates in the issue.

ci-runner: Diagnostic logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821/4821-rerun/logs (includes pg_locks snapshot and stacktrace).
